notes.title: Big Build Queue Update!
notes.notes:
By popular demand, the build queue for the starting base has been reworked!

[b]Queue Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] You can now queue items in any order, and the base will work on the first item with materials, so no more resetting the queue when you find out you don't have enough Magnets!
[*] Instructions for queuing 5 and 25 at a time are now visible.
[*] Canceling items in the queue works more intuitively now, with a cancel button on each row.
[/list]

* If your save file had queued items when you last saved before this update, you may see an extremely long queue.  To fix this click the reset queue button and re-queue your items.  This will only happen once per save at most.

[b]Other Menu updates:
[/b]Opening the main menu will now pause the game!  So no more losing your Thumpers to roaming mobs while you are AFK.

[b]Translation Updates[/b]
Fixed a few spelling errors and missing translation entries for Reinforced Iron

[b]Bugs[/b]
Several bug fixes, the biggest of which is fixing a memory leak when roaming long distances on the map.

notes.title: Belt Patch!
notes.notes: This release fixes a bug with the previous update.  Rotating belts already placed on the ground resulted in items on the belt either stopping or swapping lanes unexpectedly.  This should now work as expected.

notes.title: Performance Improvements and Bug Fixes!
notes.notes:
Version 0.3.2 is now available!

Changes in this update:
* Performance improvements when placing long runs of belts.
* Increased speed of picking up buildings when holding the right mouse button.
* Fix the Model of the Side Loading Router.
* Fix recipes for higher tier ammo for flame thrower tower.
* Improve frequency of pathing updates for Thumpers
